Content availability

Unreleased · user report

Reported unreleased by the user as of 2026-10-23. Packaged update 28 text mentions Oona; a public release date has not been established.

Campaign 3 menu lists only Fjordi’s Birthday. Oona’s Potion is absent from that menu on this installation. This supports unavailable-in-menu status; it does not establish a release date.
